template_data.headline_html: Four moves that actually build federal pipeline.

items.title: Respond to sources sought
items.desc: Treat them like a first conversation with the agency — not pre-solicitation noise. By the time the RFQ posts, the window to be a known quantity has already closed.

items.title: Show up before the RFQ
items.desc: Industry days, open houses, a capability statement intro. Contracting officers remember names — and that matters when competition opens.

items.title: Work recompetes first
items.desc: A struggling incumbent changes the math. Businesses who know this prioritize recompetes over fresh procurements.

items.title: Set NAICS alerts on SAM.gov
items.desc: Know what's moving in your space before the solicitation posts. A week of lead time on a sources sought is often all it takes.
